_comment: Hand-observed API method shapes from live probing against an authorized Enterprise Grid sandbox. Unlike state/params.json (written by the miner from web-client call sites), this file is hand-curated and the miner does not touch it. Each method lists the required params, enum values, notable errors, the token type that works, and what a successful call returns. Params were learned from validation errors (empty/junk values); no destructive writes were made.
source: live validation-error probing on an authorized Enterprise Grid sandbox org

admin.conversations.convertToPublic.notes: Admin API. Succeeds for a workspace or org admin/owner user session; a plain member gets missing_scope. admin.conversations.convertToPrivate is the inverse.

admin.roles.entity.listAssignments.notes: role_id Rl0A is the channel-manager role; entity_id is the channel id. Used to list a channel's managers.

errors.bad_action: invalid_arguments (must be a valid enum value [json-pointer:/action])

admin.sandboxes.setLimitAccess.notes: Other fields are silently ignored. No observed effect on the users.admin.inviteBulk sandbox_user_limit_reached cap.

users.admin.inviteBulk.notes: invites is a JSON-encoded string; type accepts arbitrary values and is ignored.

users.admin.setInactive.notes: Deactivating a member does not free a sandbox user-cap slot.

developer.apps.appLevelTokens.create.notes: scope connections:write produces a Socket Mode app-level token.

chat.command.notes: Runs a slash command server-side as the token's user; delivers to the app over Socket Mode / its request URL.

apps.manifest.create.returns: { app_id, credentials: { client_id, client_secret, signing_secret, verification_token }, oauth_authorize_url }
